title: $κ$-entropic statistical paradigm for relativistic corrections to the Heisenberg principle
summary: The Heisenberg position-momentum uncertainty relation is a cornerstone of quantum mechanics. However, its standard formulation is not fully consistent with special relativity. While partial understanding has been achieved in the ultra-relativistic regime, a comprehensive description is still lacking, particularly in the intermediate velocity domain, where particle speeds remain well below the speed of light yet relativistic corrections are expected to become appreciable.
